'''Jillins''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he was stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] under [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Malavai Quinn]].
